components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: Optional honorific (MR/MRS/MS/DR) used to compose the salutation.
          type: string

Build succeeds and the test passes. The audit output confirms correct behaviour: `registrationDate=2026-09-04` (September, ≥ July) yields `membershipNumber=...-M26`, matching fiscal year FY26.

## Summary

Moved date-derived values to a fiscal-year basis (fiscal year starting 1 July), keeping structural impact low by putting the logic in a small new cohesive utility so the edits to the large `OwnerMapper` class stayed minimal.

**New file** — `util/FiscalYears.java`: three tiny, low-complexity static methods:
- `startYear(date)` — calendar year the containing fiscal year began.
- `label(date)` — `FY<YY>` string.
- `elapsed(from, to)` — whole fiscal years elapsed.

**`OwnerMapper.java`** (delegations only, no added complexity):
- New `fiscalYear` DTO mapping + small `fiscalYear(owner)` helper returning `FY<YY>` from the (already business-day-adjusted) registration date.
- `membershipNumber` year segment now uses the fiscal-year start year instead of the calendar year.
- `tenureDays` (365-day counting) → `tenureFiscalYears` using `FiscalYears.elapsed`, and the membership-points rule now awards for tenure of at least one elapsed fiscal year.

**`openapi.yml`**: added the read-only `fiscalYear` schema property (generates the DTO field/setter) and updated the `membershipNumber`/`membershipPoints` descriptions to match.

One judgment call worth flagging: the spec didn't pin down the exact tenure-points threshold in fiscal-year terms, and no test covers it. I translated the old "over 365 days" (one year) to "at least one elapsed fiscal year" (`>= 1`). Easy to adjust to `> 1` if you intended strictly more than a full fiscal year.
